executable_config_contract: executable_config below is canonical; experiments/exp11_counterexample_replication/run.py DEFAULTS must match it exactly, and production CLI/config overrides require a new protocol version
scope: one fixed LJ state, N=108, one target, one radial basis
aligned_direction_convention: for this scalar target, orient the leading aligned direction so Cov(A, delta_U_aligned) <= 0 and the first-order aligned shift is non-negative
primary_estimand: cluster mean of paired aligned-minus-null direct shifts
decision: replicates in this fixed cell only if every force-match and held-out covariance-null interval passes and the cluster t interval lower bound exceeds 1 pair; practically absent only if the complete interval lies inside +/-1 pair; directionally contradicted only if its upper bound is below zero; otherwise inconclusive
fail_closed: any held-out null/aligned covariance-ratio interval whose upper limit exceeds 0.2
energy, target-observable, delta-U, or force-MSE stationarity failure
dirty, changed, or unidentifiable numerical source
